verdict: Paid channels are off; organic is holding but a key fix is needed.
narrative: This period, all pipeline activity came from organic sources — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at $0 spend and delivered 0 leads for the full 28 days. Your Google Business Profile remained active, generating 92 impressions and 79 requests for directions, but recorded 0 calls, which points to a missing or broken phone number on the listing — that is being corrected now. Your CRM captured 11 new contacts and 8 open opportunities this period, meaning intake is happening, but none of those opportunities have converted yet. Organic web traffic has also dipped in the most recent days without paid support to backstop it, so activating paid channels remains the priority heading into next period.
